text: Shawle is acting strange. Agios says it's probably because\nof the anti-Xmas force. Let's find the Dark Abies to save\nhim!
You find yourself in a place that looks like ruins. It seems\nthat the Dark Abies' power grows stronger as you go higher.\nLet's hurry to save Shawle!
You finally meet the guy who calls himself the\nForbidden Shawle. Defeat him to bring him back to his\nsenses!
